title: InviteHider
description: A mod that hides Fakepixel /joinme invites.
body:
This is a very simple mod that hides the annoying /joinme message on Fakepixel (mc.fakepixel.me).

You can easily toggle it on or off using /invitehider (enabled by default).

*Credits: ChillinPro for giving me the idea, my sanity of course and _m3l (melos propaganda)*
